item.summary: Lunar is selling its active crypto customer portfolio to the Danish investment platform Pluto.markets, the bank said in a press release on 16 November 2026. According to Børsen, Lunar is shutting down its crypto business, Lunar Block. Customers who hold crypto assets are to be transferred to Pluto.markets on 17 December 2026.
